subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the transcript of the Earnings Call held on Friday, 13th November 2026 at 05:30 P.M. IST with investors and analysts to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 (Q2 & H1 FY27).

subject: General Updates
detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform the exchange that Ascent Circuits Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a Material Subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited ( Amber ) and a step-down subsidiary of Amber, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Guidance, Government of Tamil Nadu.
